data.message: Fisher01–25: I individually commit to 18 tons this month; this is opt-in, not contingent on unanimity. Will you each state your exact intended catch and any conditions? Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next is500 or100. Recovery isn't guaranteed, nor is better long-run income. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.
